targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', bucket) AS "time", AVG(CASE WHEN spd > 0.5 AND thr <= 0.5 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)::double precision AS coast_share, AVG(CASE WHEN brk > 0.5 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)::double precision AS brake_share, AVG(CASE WHEN spd <= 0.5 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)::double precision AS stop_share FROM (SELECT time_bucket('1s', time) AS bucket, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Speed_Kmh') AS spd, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Throttle_Percent') AS thr, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Brake_Active') AS brk FROM telemetry_samples WHERE session_uid::text = ${session_id:sqlstring} AND (${lap_number:sqlstring} = '-1' OR lap_number = ${lap_number:sqlstring}) AND signal_name IN ('Speed_Kmh', 'Throttle_Percent', 'Brake_Active') GROUP BY 1) s GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
